## Why this matters
PR #249 was merged to `main` on 2026-06-14 without closing its R81 audit findings. This issue tracks the outstanding follow-up work. Feature is behind `EXPO_PUBLIC_FF_COMMUNITY_VOICE_NOTES` (default-OFF) so there is no production blast radius today, but the PR is not R81-clean and cannot be flag-flipped until findings are closed.

## What's required
- [ ] **F1 (P2)** `VoiceNotePlayer` play/pause control is 36×36 dp with no `hitSlop` — `src/components/community/VoiceNotePlayer.tsx:142-150,190-196` — fix: add `hitSlop` to the toggle `HapticPressable` so the effective touch target meets the 44/48 dp minimum
- [ ] **F2 (P2)** No dedicated screen test for `CommunityVoiceComposerScreen` — no `src/screens/community/__tests__/CommunityVoiceComposerScreen.test.tsx` — fix: add screen-level test covering `useCommunityMe`, route-param derivation, flag-off render, and `goBack` integration
- [ ] **N1 (P2)** Recorder unmount cleanup only clears the JS interval tick — it never cancels the native recorder — `src/hooks/useVoiceRecorder.ts:99-108,145-187`; `src/components/community/VoiceNoteComposer.tsx:261-272` — fix: track active capture in a ref; add unmount cleanup calling `void recorder.cancel()` when capture is active; add hook tests for unmount-while-recording and duplicate-start guard
- [ ] **F3 (P3)** No mobile-side telemetry on the voice publish/playback surface — across all PR #249 touched files — fix: add `track(...)` calls for voice publish and playback events behind `FEATURE_COMMUNITY_TELEMETRY`
- [ ] **N2 (P3)** PR #249 squash merge commit author is `BradleyGleavePortfolio <bradleyapple1031@gmail.com>` per R74 identity check — merge commit `78811c2507f6b6bfae4863038f292b99d58ffffd` — fix: do not rewrite merged history; correct merge-commit identity process for future PRs

## Already resolved
Pre-merge audit + post-merge re-audit complete. Findings list above is verified against current `main`.
